lines.en: label yasufirsthall:
scene yasuhall1
: Hey, Yasu. Having fun spending your free time just...standing in the middle of the hall?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Yasu。把空闲时间就这么……站在走廊正中间，很开心吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I would call it fun, but Touka will not let me into the room right now.
lines.zh: : 我不确定这算不算开心，不过 Touka 现在不让我进房间。

lines.en: : If you have any suggestions for a better way to spend my time, I would be happy to hear them.
lines.zh: : 要是你有更好的消磨时间的建议，我很乐意听听。

lines.en: : Well, I wouldn’t mind talking to you for a little bit. I’m sure it will keep the both of us at least mildly...entertained?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我倒不介意跟你聊上几句。我保证至少能让我们俩都……稍微有点乐子？

lines.en: : I entertain you?
lines.zh: : 我让你觉得有意思？

lines.en: : I think you go a little beyond that, but saying “entertain” is probably the easiest way to describe it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不止于此，不过用「有意思」来形容大概是最省事的说法。

lines.en: : Do I remind you of the snow on the ground? The wind in the trees?
lines.zh: : 我让你想起地上的雪了吗？树间的风？

lines.en: : No. You remind me of a girl who likely needs professional help but will not receive any.
lines.zh: : 没有。你让我想起一个大概需要专业心理干预、却永远得不到的女孩。

lines.en: : What a strangely specific type of girl.
lines.zh: : 真是具体得离奇的一类女孩。

lines.en: : Is that what you would call your “type?”
lines.zh: : 这就是你说的「你的菜」吗？

lines.en: : Are you hitting on me right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在撩我吗？

lines.en: : Romance is out of the question until my wings grow in, Sensei. For now, I am just trying to evaluate you.
lines.zh: : 在我的翅膀长出来之前，谈情说爱免谈，Sensei。眼下我只是在评估你。

lines.en: : It will come in handy soon.
lines.zh: : 很快就会派上用场的。
: 为什么？……

lines.en: scene yasuhall2
: Because soon, you’ll finally be ready to see where I’ve been hiding all this time.
lines.zh: : 因为很快，你终于就能准备好去看我一直以来藏身的地方了。

lines.en: : Where I found solace when the world would not have me.
lines.zh: : 那个在全世界都不肯接纳我时，给了我慰藉的地方。

lines.en: : Is that just a really convoluted way of saying that you prefer cold weather over the heat?
lines.zh: : 你绕这么大一个圈子，其实就是想说你比起热天更喜欢冷天？

lines.en: scene yasuhall3
: I both love and hate the summer at the same time.
lines.zh: : 我对夏天是又爱又恨，两种感情同时存在。

lines.en: : It’s quite complicated. I can’t really talk about it here.
lines.zh: : 这事说来很复杂。在这里我没法细讲。

lines.en: : Why? You’re not going to tell me a top secret organization is conducting a surveillance mission on you or something, right?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你不会打算告诉我，有什么绝密组织在对你搞监视行动之类的吧？

lines.en: : That’s something a crazy person would say.
lines.zh: : 那是疯子才会说的话。

lines.en: : So you {i}are{/i} going to tell me that...
lines.zh: : 所以你{i}还真{/i}打算告诉我……

lines.en: scene yasuhall4
: If we talk too loudly about things we’re not allowed to talk about yet, the floor will open up and swallow us.
lines.zh: : 要是我们把现在还不许谈的事情谈得太大声，地板就会裂开，把我们吞下去。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s not a thing that happens.
lines.zh: : 得了吧，这种事根本不会发生。

lines.en: scene yasuhall1
: Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: : But I saw it with my own eyes, Sensei. The reckoning.
lines.zh: : 可我亲眼看见了，Sensei。那场清算。

lines.en: : The hole that swallowed everything.
lines.zh: : 那个吞噬了一切的洞。

lines.en: : The...hole that-
lines.zh: : 那个……洞，它——

lines.en: : Wait, you’re not talking about Kumon-mi Academy, are you?
lines.zh: : 等等，你说的该不会是 Kumon-mi 学园吧？

lines.en: scene yasuhall5
: {i}Slip.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}说漏嘴了。{/i}

lines.en: : ...Is that a yes or a no?
lines.zh: : ……这算「是」还是「不是」？

lines.en: : It’s an answer.
lines.zh: : 这是个答案。

lines.en: : One I can share with you the moment you open your eyes.
lines.zh: : 等你睁开眼睛的那一刻，我就能跟你分享的答案。

lines.en: : When will you be ready to open your eyes?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候才准备好睁开眼睛？

lines.en: : I really wish you’d stop asking me that while I’m looking directly at you.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你能别在我直勾勾看着你的时候问这个。

lines.en: : When will you be ready to be saved, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候才准备好被拯救，Sensei？

lines.en: : When will you be ready to be cleansed?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候才准备好被净化？

lines.en: : Cleansed of what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 净化什么，具体说说？

lines.en: scene yasuhall6
: All of the filth this world has to offer.
lines.zh: : 这世上所有的污秽。

lines.en: : Let us wash it all away together.
lines.zh: : 让我们一起把它们洗刷干净吧。

lines.en: : You know, I’m normally the type to jump at an opportunity to shower with a cute girl, but I have a feeling I might not ever make it back if I accept this offer right now.
lines.zh: : 你要知道，平时有跟可爱女孩一起洗澡的机会我肯定抢着上，但我有种感觉——要是现在答应你，我可能就回不来了。

lines.en: : Make it back to where? It’s not as if this place is of any value to either of us.
lines.zh: : 回哪里去？这地方对我们俩都没什么价值可言。

lines.en: : It’s so much harder to feel the ground tremble from up on the second floor.
lines.zh: : 在二楼，连地面的震颤都难感觉得到。

lines.en: : Even if you lay down and press your cheek against the carpet of this very hall, you’d be lucky to feel anything at all.
lines.zh: : 就算你躺下来，把脸贴在这条走廊的地毯上，能感觉到点什么就算你走运了。

lines.en: : Please don’t put your face on the carpet here. I don’t think it’s vacuumed very often.
lines.zh: : 别把脸往这儿的地毯上贴。我觉得这儿不常吸尘。

lines.en: scene yasuhall7
: Will agreeing to your demands bring you closer to the desire for salvation?
lines.zh: : 答应我的要求，能让你离那份想要被救赎的心愿更近一步吗？

lines.en: : No, but it will keep you from getting dirty.
lines.zh: : 不能，但能让你不至于弄脏。

lines.en: : That which is white can never be dirty.
lines.zh: : 洁白之物是永远脏不了的。

lines.en: : That is very much not true, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 这话可大错特错了，Yasu。

lines.en: : In fact, I’d say it’s the complete opposite.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我觉得恰恰相反。

lines.en: : That’s a nice dress and you wouldn’t want it to get ruined.
lines.zh: : 这条裙子挺好看的，你总不会想把它毁了吧。

lines.en: scene yasuhall8
: Nice?...
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : This dress is hideous.
lines.zh: : 这条裙子丑死了。

lines.en: : I want to tear it off right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就想把它撕下来。

lines.en: : You know, I tried giving you a compliment and being a nice guy, but then you went and said that. And now I’m stuck questioning my morals like I always am.
lines.zh: : 我明明试着夸你一句、当个好人，结果你来了这么一出。现在我又像往常一样，开始怀疑自己的道德底线了。

lines.en: scene yasuhall9
: The funny thing about morals is that they are focused on what is right and what is wrong.
lines.zh: : 道德这东西有意思的地方在于，它只盯着什么是对的、什么是错的。

lines.en: : Yes. That is absolutely hilarious.
lines.zh: : 是啊。真是好笑得要命。

lines.en: : But when we are nothing more than subjects for who we believe created us, aren’t morals rather silly?
lines.zh: : 可当我们不过是我们所信仰的造物主的臣民时，道德是不是就显得很可笑了？

lines.en: : If I think something is right and you think something is wrong, but we are both virtuous in our beliefs, which one of us is truly right?
lines.zh: : 如果我觉得一件事是对的，你觉得它是错的，而我们俩都坚信自己的信念是正当的，那到底谁才是真正对的？

lines.en: : That’s a good point. If everything is subjective then-
lines.zh: : 说得有道理。要是一切都是主观的，那——

lines.en: scene yasuhall10
: BZZZT! Wrong answer!
lines.zh: : 哔——！回答错误！

lines.en: scene yasuhall5
: My answer is the truly right one! Yours will only make the pain worse!
lines.zh: : 我的答案才是真正正确的！你的答案只会让痛苦更重！

lines.en: : The solution is to follow my lead! To see the things I see as right as virtuous in your own, {s}tainted{/s} purified eyes.
lines.zh: : 解决办法就是跟着我走！用你那双既被{s}玷污{/s}又被净化的眼睛，把我眼中正确的事也看成正当的事。

lines.en: : Does your vision ever get cloudy, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你的视线有没有模糊过，Sensei？

lines.en: : Tell me all of the horrible things you see, and I will swallow them whole.
lines.zh: : 把你看到的所有可怕的东西都告诉我，我会把它们整个吞下去。

lines.en: scene yasuhall11
: I will swallow anything and everything that you ask of me.
lines.zh: : 你要我吞什么，我就吞什么。

lines.en: scene yasuhall12
: Same.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: : Thanks, Kirin. I had a feeling you were going to chime in there.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Kirin。我就知道你会插一嘴。

lines.en: : That girl is fucking weird, Sensei. Come hang out with me and Noriko instead.
lines.zh: : 那丫头他妈的古怪死了，Sensei。来跟我和 Noriko 玩吧。

lines.en: : Maybe some other time...
lines.zh: : 改天吧……

lines.en: : Are you ready?
lines.zh: : 你准备好了吗？

lines.en: : For...the swallowing?
lines.zh: : 准备……被吞？

lines.en: : For the {i}sanctuary.{/i}
lines.zh: : 准备去那个{i}圣所{/i}。

lines.en: : For the place that can not be swallowed by the hole that swallows everything.
lines.zh: : 去那个不会被「吞噬一切的洞」吞噬的地方。

lines.en: : A place where we can cleanse ourselves together...and hide when the heat becomes too much for our pitiful bodies to bear.
lines.zh: : 一个我们可以一起洗净自身的地方……也是一个在天热得我们可怜的身体受不了时，可以躲进去的地方。

lines.en: : A place where God does not live, but very much likes to visit when the time is right.
lines.zh: : 一个神不住在里面、但时机对了就非常喜欢来做客的地方。

lines.en: : I want to show you that place, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我想带你去看那个地方，Sensei。

lines.en: : It sounds a lot like you’re inviting me to a church right now.
lines.zh: : 听着怎么这么像你在邀请我去教堂啊。

lines.en: scene yasuhall13
: You actually {i}are{/i} inviting me to a church aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你还{i}真是{/i}在邀请我去教堂啊？

lines.en: scene yasuhall14
: I’d be very happy if you came.
lines.zh: : 你要是能来，我会非常高兴。

lines.en: : I just want to help you.
lines.zh: : 我只是想帮你。

lines.en: : I don’t think so, Yasu. I’m not really a religious person.
lines.zh: : 我看还是算了，Yasu。我这人不太信教。

lines.en: scene yasuhall8
: Then why do you reek of a {i}shrine?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那你身上为什么一股{i}神社{/i}的味道？

lines.en: : First off, rude.
lines.zh: : 第一，你这么说很失礼。

lines.en: : Second, shrines don’t have a scent.
lines.zh: : 第二，神社是没有气味的。

lines.en: scene yasuhall7
: But gods do. And I am very very very very very very very very very very {i}very{/i} good when it comes to sniffing out things like that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 但神有。而且我在嗅这类东西上非常非常非常非常非常非常非常非常非常非常{i}非常{/i}地厉害，Sensei。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind showing up to hang out with you I guess, but...
lines.zh: : 去跟你玩玩我倒是不介意，不过……

lines.en: : Wait, hold on. This is a bad idea. I shouldn’t be going to see you in a place like a church where there are other people around.
lines.zh: : 等等，不对。这是个坏主意。我不该去教堂那种周围还有别人的地方见你。

lines.en: scene yasuhall3
: There is only me.
lines.zh: : 那里只有我。

lines.en: : It’s a special place that only the chosen can enter.
lines.zh: : 那是个只有被选中者才能进去的地方。

lines.en: : Then how the hell will I get in? I haven’t been chosen at all.
lines.zh: : 那我到底怎么进去？我可一点都没被选中。

lines.en: : I’m choosing you right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就选你。

lines.en: : Come, wash away your sins with me.
lines.zh: : 来吧，和我一起洗去你的罪。

lines.en: : I will not ask you to pray and will not stop you if you want to leave.
lines.zh: : 我不会要求你祈祷，你想走我也不会拦你。

lines.en: : All I ask is that you come.
lines.zh: : 我只求你来。

lines.en: : Ugh, fine. Whatever. But I’m literally only doing this because you’re cute.
lines.zh: : 唉，行吧，随便了。不过我真的只是因为你可爱才答应的。

lines.en: scene yasuhall6
: Hehehehehehehahahahahahehhahahaha!!!
lines.zh: : 呵呵呵呵呵呵哈哈哈哈哈哈嘿嘿哈哈哈哈哈！！！

lines.en: : No romance, Sensei! Not without God’s approval!
lines.zh: : 不可以谈情说爱，Sensei！没有神的准许就不行！

lines.en: What the fuck did I just get myself into?
lines.zh: 我他妈的到底把自己卷进什么鬼事里了？

lines.en: scene black
Yasu takes one of her gloves off and removes an old newspaper clipping that she had been carrying around in there for some reason.
lines.zh: Yasu 脱下一只手套，从里面取出一张不知为什么一直随身带着的旧报纸剪报。

lines.en: She places it into my hands and then clasps them together, bringing herself to her toes to try and whisper into my ear.
lines.zh: 她把剪报放进我手里，然后把我的手合上，踮起脚，想凑到我耳边说悄悄话。

lines.en: I crouch down a bit to help her.
lines.zh: 我稍微蹲下一点，方便她够到。

lines.en: : {i}Praise be.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}赞美圣名。{/i}

lines.en: : That’s it? That’s all you wanted to whisper?
lines.zh: : 就这样？你想跟我咬耳朵就为说这个？

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei. The time has come again for me to pray.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei。我又该去祷告了。

lines.en: : The answer to all of your troubles can be found on that sheet of paper.
lines.zh: : 你所有烦恼的答案，都在那张纸上。

lines.en: Yasu disappears back into her room and I...
lines.zh: Yasu 转身消失在自己房间里，而我……

lines.en: Well, I...go home.
lines.zh: 怎么说呢……回家了。

lines.en: $ yasufirsthall = True
$ yasu_love += 1
{i}Yasu’s affection has increased to [yasu_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yasu 的好感度提升到了 [yasu_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Congratulations! You may now visit New Hope Cathedral!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你现在可以前往新希望大教堂了！{/i}
